肿瘤突变负荷（**TMB**，每 Mb 非同义突变数）在癌种之间跨越两个数量级，而每个肿瘤的 **Ti/Tv 组成**（六类替换）指纹化其突变过程——自发脱氨偏 C>T，紫外线暴露偏 C>A \[1\]。参考图将每个肿瘤一个点按中位 TMB 排序塞入队列柱内，柱下配一条共享样本顺序的 Ti/Tv 堆叠条。本教程用 base graphics 在模拟队列上复现完整组合图：

```{r packages setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, output=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
```

```{r}
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")
```

## 数据准备

8 个模拟队列的逐样本 TMB（围绕植入中位数对数正态，THCA → SKCM 递增）+ 逐样本 Dirichlet Ti/Tv 分数（队列特异浓度：THCA 偏脱氨（C>T 主导），SKCM 偏紫外（C>A 主导））。真实数据中两张表均来自 `maftools`：TMB 取自 `getSampleSummary()`（除以 ~35 Mb 外显子），分数取自 `titv(maf, plot = FALSE)$fraction.contribution`：

```{r load data}
set.seed(13901)
cohorts <- c("THCA", "KIRC", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "STAD", "LUAD", "SKCM")
med_tmb <- c(0.4, 0.9, 1.4, 2.2, 4.5, 7.0, 8.5, 15)
n_sm    <- c(70, 60, 65, 90, 60, 55, 70, 80)
cls <- c("C>T", "T>C", "C>A", "C>G", "T>A", "T>G")
npg <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4")
names(npg) <- cls
## Dirichlet concentrations per cohort: THCA spontaneous deamination (C>T),
## SKCM UV signature (C>A) — the etiologies the Ti/Tv strip must reveal
conc <- list(
  THCA = c(22, 4, 1.5, 1.5, 2.5, 1.5),
  KIRC = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 3, 2),  PRAD = c(7, 4, 2.5, 2, 2.5, 1.8),
  BRCA = c(6, 4, 3.5, 2, 3, 2), COAD = c(10, 4, 2, 2, 3, 2),
  STAD = c(6, 4, 4, 2, 3.5, 2), LUAD = c(5, 4, 5, 2, 3.5, 2),
  SKCM = c(3, 2, 18, 1.5, 2.5, 1.5))
TMB.dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cohorts), function(i) {
  data.frame(cohort = cohorts[i], Tumor_Sample_Barcode = sprintf("%s_%03d", cohorts[i], 1:n_sm[i]),
             TMB = pmax(0.05, exp(rnorm(n_sm[i], log(med_tmb[i]), 0.75))))
}))
titv.dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cohorts, function(cc) {
  k <- match(cc, cohorts)
  g <- matrix(rgamma(n_sm[k] * 6, shape = rep(conc[[cc]], times = n_sm[k]), rate = 3),
              ncol = 6, byrow = TRUE)
  f <- g / rowSums(g); colnames(f) <- cls
  data.frame(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = sprintf("%s_%03d", cc, 1:n_sm[k]), f, check.names = FALSE)
}))
```

## Visualization

### TMB 散点 + Ti/Tv 条

组合图：队列内按 TMB 升序排布的样本点呈现队列内分布形态；灰段为队列中位数；下方条带复用同一从左到右的样本顺序，使各队列的突变信号与其 TMB 对齐——THCA 读出脱氨（红 C>T），SKCM 读出紫外（绿 C>A）：

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1TmbTitv
#| fig-cap: "8 个模拟队列的肿瘤突变负荷（log10(TMB+1)，按中位数升序；灰段 = 中位数），配共享样本顺序的逐队列 Ti/Tv 分数条：THCA 以 C>T 为主（脱氨），SKCM 以 C>A 为主（紫外）。"
#| out.width: "100%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5

tcga.cohort.med <- TMB.dat %>% group_by(cohort) %>% summarise(median = median(TMB)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% .[order(.$median), ]
TMB.dat$cohort <- factor(TMB.dat$cohort, levels = tcga.cohort.med$cohort)
TMB.dat <- TMB.dat[order(TMB.dat$cohort, TMB.dat$TMB), ]
TMB.plot <- lapply(split(TMB.dat, TMB.dat$cohort), function(x)
  data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, length.out = nrow(x)), TMB = x$TMB))
sampleorder <- lapply(split(TMB.dat, TMB.dat$cohort), `[[`, "Tumor_Sample_Barcode")
titv.dat2 <- lapply(tcga.cohort.med$cohort, function(cc) {
  tmp <- titv.dat[match(sampleorder[[cc]], titv.dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode), cls]
  t(tmp)                                   # 6 x n, each column a sample
})
tcga.cohort.med$logmed <- log10(tcga.cohort.med$median + 1)
nc <- length(cohorts)

## scatter panel; strip x-positions derived from par("usr")/par("plt") so the
## Ti/Tv strips align exactly with each cohort's slot on the scatter
par(mar = c(11, 2.5, 2, 0), mgp = c(3, 0.6, 0))
y_lims <- range(log10(TMB.dat$TMB + 1))
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(0, nc), ylim = y_lims, xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xaxs = "r",
     ylab = "", xlab = "", main = "Tumour mutation burden across cohorts (simulated)")
mtext("log10(TMB+1)", side = 2, line = 1.4, cex = 0.9)
invisible(lapply(seq_len(nc), function(i) {
  tmp <- TMB.plot[[i]]
  points(tmp$x + i - 1, log10(tmp$TMB + 1), pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = "black")
  segments(i - 1, tcga.cohort.med$logmed[i], i, tcga.cohort.med$logmed[i], col = "grey45", lwd = 2)
}))
axis(side = 1, at = seq(0.5, nc - 0.5, 1), labels = tcga.cohort.med$cohort,
     las = 2, cex.axis = 0.8, tick = FALSE)
axis(side = 2, at = 0:2, las = 2)
usr <- par("usr"); pltr <- par("plt")
devx <- function(u) pltr[1] + (u - usr[1]) / (usr[2] - usr[1]) * (pltr[2] - pltr[1])
invisible(lapply(seq_len(nc), function(i) {
  par(fig = c(devx(i - 1), devx(i), 0.03, 0.17), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  barplot(titv.dat2[[i]], col = npg[rownames(titv.dat2[[i]])],
          names.arg = rep("", ncol(titv.dat2[[i]])), axes = FALSE, space = 0, border = NA)
  box()
}))
par(fig = c(0, 0.1, 0.03, 0.22), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE)
legend("center", fill = npg, legend = names(npg), bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
```


## 应用场景

::: {#fig-TmbTitvApplications1}
![](../images/TmbTitvPlot_demo.png){fig-alt="TMB + Ti/Tv 泛癌版式" fig-align="center" width="60%"}

TMB + Ti/Tv 泛癌版式
:::

列内打包散点 + 信号条带版式可推广到任何逐样本定量 + 组成型谱的组合：突变负荷与 signature 暴露、CNV 负荷与断点谱、药物 IC50 与靶点表达分数。
